name: Sikafloor® MultiFlex PB-56 UV
tagline: Trafficable, waterproof, UV stable and slip resistant Polyurethane flooring system
summary: Sikafloor® MultiFlex PB-56 UV is a polyurethane, coloured, elastic, UV resistant, crack-bridging, slip-resistant flooring system and is part of the Sikafloor® Multiflex flooring range. It provides a hard wearing, seamless, chemical resistant, low maintenance, slip resistant finish when broadcast with different aggregate grades and sealed with a gloss finish seal coat. Varying thickness’s can be achieved from 2,5 –3,5 mm. Internal and external use.

items.label: SUSTAINABILITY
items.text: Conformity with LEED v2009 IEQc 4.2: Low-Emitting Materials - Paints and Coatings - Sikafloor®-377

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to EN 1504-2 - Surface protection product for concrete - Coating - Sikafloor®-160, Sikafloor®-161, Sikafloor®-376, Sikafloor®-359 N
CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to EN 13813 - Resin screed material for internal use in buildings - Sikafloor®-160, Sikafloor®-161, Sikafloor®-376, Sikafloor®-359 N

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Layer | Product
1. Primer | Sikafloor®-160/-161 + Aggregate broadcast 0,4–0,8 mm
2. Wearing layer | Sikafloor®-376 + Aggregate broadcast 0,4–0,8 mm
3. Seal / top coat | Sikafloor®-359 N

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Sikafloor® MultiFlex PB-56 UV always has to be sealed with Sikafloor®-359 N. Refer to the chemical resistance of Sikafloor®-359 N.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: The substrate and uncured floor products must be at least +3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or surface damage of the floor finish.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: ≤ 4 % parts by weight Test method: Sika®-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene-sheet).

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Temperature | Foot traffic | Light traffic | Full cure
+15 °C | ~48 hours | ~5 days | ~10 days
+20 °C | ~24 hours | ~3 days | ~7 days
+30 °C | ~16 hours | ~2 days | ~3 days
Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Layer | Product | Consumption
1. Primer | Sikafloor®-160 / 161 + Aggregate broadcast 0,4–0,8 mm | ~0,4 kg/m2/layer ~1,0 kg/m2 (Broadcast Sand)
2. Wearing layer | Sikafloor®-376 (filled with 1:0.2 with Sikafloor Filler) + Aggregate broadcast 0,4–0,8 mm | ~2,1 kg/m2 (resin) + ~0,42 kg/m2 (Sikafloor Filler ) ~6,0–8,0 kg/m2 (Broadcast Sand)
3.Seal / top coat | Sikafloor®-359 N | ~0,7–0,9 kg/m2/ total consumption applied in 2 x coats for best results
These figures are theoretical and do not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level or wastage etc.
